name: Normalized Uncertainty
description: Implementation of Normalized Uncertainty (NU, at the calibration a = b = 1 that needs no estimate), Normalized Growth Uncertainty (NGU) and Asymmetry Coherence (AC) from survey density forecasts, with the scripts reproducing the public-data exhibits of the working papers 'Uncertain and Asymmetric Forecasts' and 'Tolerable Inflation, Intolerable Uncertainty' (Eric Vansteenberghe, Banque de France).
